notes.title: New DLC: Kleff!
notes.content:
[h3]Our free DLC is here! Discover Kleff our new blade prince![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/4c3cd4e05c89cc5ee4eb6959ea06bed36e11d5ca.jpg[/img]

Step into the shadows with this free DLC for Blade Prince Academy, introducing [b]Kleff the Rat Assassin[/b]. This cunning new character focuses on physical damage to single targets with his [b]exceptional attack speed[/b]. Kleff's spells include armor debuffs and several support abilities designed to trigger devastating combos during missions.

Kleff comes with his own narrative arc and unique character dialogues to discover throughout the base game.

[h3]Who is Kleff?[/h3]
Kleff is a mysterious rat animalid born in the catacombs, in a tribe of ratmen. To survive and protect his clan, he trained at a young age to become a ruthless assassin. But his talents aroused the hatred of his rivals, who massacred Kleff's family in retaliation. After taking revenge by executing the murderers, he goes by himself to an inquisition barracks to be tried and imprisoned. But given Kleff's young age and the impressive number of thugs he had killed, the inquisitors made the decision to send him to the Blade Prince Academy.

On his forehead, his third eye offers the gift of premonition. He is capable of anticipating all the movements of his opponents in a combat situation, and reacting with dazzling speed, formidable precision, and deadly grace. Naturally, he specialized in infiltration and assassination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/3a23bb3b32943e78fa059e9d4783145797e6c8e7.png[/img]
[h3]What are his specificities?[/h3]
[b]Spells[/b]
[list]
[*] Armor Debuff: Weaken enemy defenses, making them more vulnerable to your attacks.
[*] Position Switch Spell: Swap places with an ally or enemy, creating dynamic positioning advantages.
[*] Fog Zone Creation: Conjure fog zones to obscure vision, perfect for setting up devastating combos.
[*] Status Effects: Inflict poison, bleeding, and resistance debuffs to steadily wear down your foes.
[*] Fatigue Management: Kleff inflicts Fatigue on himself regularly, but his combo effects can remove these debuffs, adding an extra layer of strategy.[/list]
[b]How to unlock Kleff[/b]
[olist]
[*] Unlocked automatically from sector 2.
[*] Starts at level 3, ready to join your team with a head start.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/f96c1150dc2b3dd40f91caa9d02f79ad922c8322.png[/img]

We hope you will enjoy this new DLC! Let us know what you think in the Steam discussions!


- The Blade Prince Academy team -

notes.title: Tips to start your journey at the Academy
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Blade Princes,

To help you in your Academy's journey, we created a[b] [url=https://firesquid.games/wikis/blade-prince-academy]Wiki[/url][/b]!

Do you have what it takes to survive and thrive in this dreadful city?

No worries dear students, in this article, you will find[b] 5 tips [/b]to understand the mechanics better and be a master on the battlefield.

[h2]1/ Mastering chain of command for effective chain reactions[/h2]

In Blade Prince Academy, strategizing the order of actions is key. Plan a sequence of moves where each action sets off the next, creating a domino effect. This approach is especially effective in battles where timing and order of operations can turn the tide in your favour. Experiment with different combinations to find the most effective chain reactions for various scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/e1817aa199ff695984b2d45eab1701db9044c954.png[/img]

[h2]2/ Utilizing the environment to your advantage[/h2]

Pay attention to environmental elements, like barrels in sector 1, that can be used strategically. Triggering these at the right moment can inflict significant damage on enemies. Use abilities like Phoebos Jump to swiftly move out of the area-of-effect of these environmental hazards, ensuring your safety while damaging foes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/2e5a0a2bd2dcc44e6bacdc3271794f83d3cc2856.png[/img]

[h2]3/ Pact picking for character progession[/h2]

Choosing the appropriate pact for each character dramatically impacts their performance. For a character like O’Ren, opting for a pact that boosts attack speed can be highly beneficial. This enhancement allows him to shoot faster, thereby increasing his damage output over time. It's essential to evaluate how each pact complements a character’s unique abilities and combat style, especially when considering long-term playthrough strategies. This foresight in pact selection can make a significant difference in both offensive and defensive scenarios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/f93948dcd79698848068d67277878e2c81c21ca2.png[/img]

[h2]4/ Understanding and utilizing combos[/h2]

Early on, experiment with basic combos to understand how different attacks can be combined. Pay close attention to the tooltips of each attack, which provide valuable information on potential combinations and effects. Mastering combos can significantly increase your effectiveness in battles, allowing for more powerful and efficient attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/7bb0a48090488cf9ff4cd564e2daf1a4f42ae33e.png[/img]

[h2]5/ Strategic movement and placement[/h2]

Positioning is crucial in Blade Prince Academy. Always be mindful of your surroundings to avoid enemy charge attacks and friendly fire. Use movement strategically to maintain a favourable position, both for offensive actions and defensive manoeuvres. Learning to anticipate enemy moves and adjusting your placement accordingly can be a game-changer in tough battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/25a99440020d4310cc60c39a76604d2ec4c3989e.png[/img]

If you want to hear more and see those tips in actions, you can watch this video:
[previewyoutube=941BWIHKIrQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Those are just some beginners advice but remember that you are the master of your own story and you will create a strategy of your own; do not hesitate to share with us and the other students your amazing plans to defeat Abjectalia's threats!

Have a great time at the Academy and thank you for protecting our dear city!

- The Blade Prince Academy team -

notes.title: Focus on the enemies and threat level system
notes.content:
Hey Blade Princes,

What makes a hero’s journey more epic? Its [b]villains[/b]! In this devblog, we will dig deeper into some of the enemies you will have to face, but also the unique threat level feature that will spice up all those combats!

[h2]Who’s threatening Abjectalia?[/h2]

Many threats are lurking over the city, and the Blade Princes have a lot of work to do. The different sectors that divide Abjectalia can be similar to biomes, with the idea that each one of them has their own identity, but moreover, what's our topic of the day, their own villains.

[list]
[*] [b]The Shallows[/b], also known as Sector 1, are for example a gang-ridden place where [b]the Acid Pillz[/b] terrorize the poor population of the suburbs. Inspired by the Mad Max universe, these thugs fit perfectly into a steampunk atmosphere like the one of the Shallows. This punk-poison mix is reminded by bright colours like green and magenta, just like many poisonous animals in nature have vibrant colours themselves! You can find this neon colours palette in the landscapes with the graffitis and the barrels, but also on the enemies themselves with their mohawk haircut. The Acid Pillz have eliminated all the other gangs in the area, making profit from drug-dealing and human-trafficking. Charming bunch, aren't they?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/cf88f385ac45d9fd8d11fadba8784a78166fca72.png[/img]
[*] Sector 2, [b]The Catacombs[/b], is not short on enemies. In this gigantic “graveyard-city” with a lovecraftian touch, the dead are stored, and the inhabitants have developed a morbid culture made of cults worshiping death and the afterlife. This heavy atmosphere that reigns in this part of Abjectalia is emphasize by the more dark and gloomy colours like grey and black. Sometimes a strike of vibrant purple will slice this ambience, like lightning in a bad weather. [b]The Kindred of Torments[/b] is the main cult of the Catacombs, with the goddess Arachnea as their patron deity. Her followers will be ferocious opponents, with their faith funneling their black magic and forbidden rituals. After all, how ferocious is an enemy who is not afraid of death?
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/c5e63fbff33a28edf2d786f2fba9c3b394fb7820.gif[/img]

As for other sectors and enemies… Well, let’s keep the surprise, shall we?

Each enemy encountered by the Blade Princes is a new step taken towards the top of the power chain in Abjectalia. Within the same sector, you will face different kinds of minions, but most importantly, the big bad evil bosses! Yes, there is a plural here, as territories are disputed by various individuals with their own purposes and powers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/f79948f38e4b5a7e9a4d25201444d8f9c1bad149.png[/img]
Narratively speaking, we wanted this escalation of threat and power in the enemies to be a representation of the Blade Princes' growing maturity and strength through all the hardships they face. Many different plots are happening in Abjectalia, and it was paramount that the critical state of the city was seen through all the different antagonists that want to claim power over it.

[h2]Threat level is in your hands[/h2]

In Blade Prince Academy, the dangerousness of each mission is determined by[b] the player’s decisions[/b]. Indeed, if missions start with a threat level of a certain intensity, this score can increase depending on different actions:

[list]
[*] Opening chests
[*] Choosing a more powerful pact
[*] Getting rid of enemies
[*] Opening doors without keys
[*] Losing at the casino roulette
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/cfac2056d879553fd79d3f386f01d90ff1dbcebf.gif[/img]

The UI was a critical aspect to set up in regard to the importance those choices create. Building tension and fear in the player was the main goal of the threat level UI, with the skull getting angrier with each level and the red color reminding the player of the growing challenges they will face. There was a balance to find between highlighting this difficulty meter with graphic assets and not overcharging the screen with too much elements, keeping the UI readable. 

Since many mechanics depend on this data, we wanted the threat level to feel like a danger hanging over the player constantly, as opposed to a one-time event that will disappear from the screen and, later on, the mind of the player. With the angry skull and its loading bar always apparent, the idea was to understand which difficulty you are currently facing and, when having to make decisions, doing them while knowing if it is worth it or not.


[h2]Toughest challenges, best rewards[/h2]

Threat level does not impact the visuals of the enemies, however, their number, their animosity, and their strength are increased. Stats such as Life, Damage, Resistance, and Haste are upgraded, making them [b]a much more aggressive challenge[/b] for the player. This feature can create a unique experience for the same sector, with some enemies being tougher than they used to be or making more of them spawn in a place that was previously empty.

Dealing with more and more dangerous individuals is one thing, but challenging oneself is not the only profit to gain from such victories. We wanted the player to really feel the impact of winning a tough combat and the satisfaction that comes from it. A Special Pact reward is delivered to players who beat the highest threat level menaces, but they also gain more experience as well as skullz money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/26cf1895db54dd700650a2bd6f3229c1dbee3a09.png[/img]

Now, you have read everything there is to know to face the hostile world of Abjectalia and to protect its citizens! Thank you for reading this devblog, let us know what you think about the threat level system and how you can influence it!

And we also created a Tiktok account, you can find it here: https://www.tiktok.com/@bladeprinces


Stay tuned for the next insights into the creation of Blade Prince Academy, more news are coming in the next weeks! 

- The Blade Prince Academy Team -

notes.title: Developing the relationship system and combo mechanics
notes.content:
Hey Blades Princes,
 
Happy New Year (we’re still in January!), and we hope you had lovely holidays! Let's celebrate the new year with a [b]devblog on what we’ve been up to[/b] and how development is progressing. Time to tackle some of the biggest features we’ve been focusing on and what changed. Our topics for today’s devblog are [b]the relationship and combo systems[/b]. They are quite significant in terms of gameplay, and you may have noticed some parts of them during the playtest between November and December.


[h2]The influence of the relationship system on the gameplay[/h2]

The relationship system plays a crucial role in [b]shaping the dynamics of the Blade Princes[/b], while also [b]affecting their powers[/b]. As you increase relationships between them, they [b]unlock various benefits[/b]. When characters are together on a mission, they gain [b]bonus stats[/b]. Additionally, each level of relationship brings not only stat bonuses but also triggers [b]visual novel events[/b] between the two characters. At the maximum relationship level between two characters, you will have access to a final visual novel scene, but you will also benefit from the highest stat bonus possible and obtain a powerful item known as a [b]"Memory"[/b], akin to a "Pact", but much more powerful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/fad5b01ad32ef6e10b9081790047d7d641752470.png[/img]

The relationship system is designed to [b]add more depth[/b] to the lives of the Academy and the Blade Princes’. It’s also a way to let you [b]see your progress[/b] and the [b]impact of your decisions[/b]—who you decided to team up with and if you wanted to nurture your character's relationships. So, as you can guess, you earn relationship points by playing with your selected Blade Princes in missions and engaging in the available dialogues in the Park, at the Academy Hub.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/25c24a126075067cfa61a78426c8574660092590.png[/img]

The [b]relationship gauge is cut into levels[/b] and gradually fills. At each level, you can access personalized relationship dialogues for each Blade Prince duo. This [b]system rewards you for progressing with your favorite characters[/b] by granting bonus stats. Once you fill out the gauge, you will be able to choose between "True Friendship" and "True Love", providing you with a unique and powerful relationship Pact depending on your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/b0e5c98161c65a217db3e0ccf0c2fdf02c53481a.png[/img]


[h2]Synergies based on alterations, the roots of the combo mechanics[/h2]

It may feel out of topic, but it’s still linked to your character's connections in a way. Combos have improved quite a bit in the past few months. Spell combos are built around [b]synergies[/b] between characters. There are [b]10 alterations[/b] in the game, and [b]each Blade Prince can cast 3 to 4[/b] of them. They are the conditions that make a combo possible. We made sure to have synergies between each character, every character needs another to launch a combo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/ab8c1f33958113a5ff2981f2a891581cfb62adff.png[/img]

[b]Specific alterations are required[/b], depending on the characters and attacks you choose. The Tactical pause mode highlights enemies with the right combination of alterations, and the Blade Princes with [b]available combos are outlined in gold[/b]. Successfully executing a combo triggers visual effects like a screen shake and a prominent "COMBO" message to reward your tactical moves and emphasize the boosted damage inflicted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/a745d85c1736d5d577dc05cb11ef2f33a6c6db17.png[/img]

This has been a matter that required [b]multiple iterations[/b] to make sure that it was easily and visually understood when you met the right conditions to trigger a combo with which character, which spell, and which enemies. The feature needed some visual emphasis for this purpose, and we believe we found the right solution for this!

On top of this, you may have noticed that we decided to make the difference between damage-dealing spells, healing spells, and buff spells more visible by [b]adding a colored filter[/b] depending on the category (red for attack, green for heal, blue for buff, and yellow for affliction, without damage).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/0f2c0fbd27d3ff9ea270640efea425d41d707ea3.png[/img]


[h2]The evolution of the dialogues and the creation of the Park[/h2]

The development of the Park was influenced by the need for new panels in the Academy Hub, stemming from the [b]rework of the Blade Princes[/b] into more unique heroes and the [b]removal of panels[/b] like Recruitment and the Cemetery. The suppression of these panels changed, on a deeper level, how [b]the dynamics between characters[/b] worked.
 
And so it was born! The Park dialogues quickly took the form of [b]choice dialogues for narrative purposes[/b] and to give you some actions to take narratively. But we were still facing one issue: when designing the Park, we came to realize that the choices at the end of a mission didn't work anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/58985df71741dd3891bbdbcd14507b80a3827f27.png[/img]

The dialogues at the end of missions were still in the game, made for less unique heroes at the time, which means they weren't as personalized. As much as we liked this feature, we understood it didn’t fit in the game anymore. Originally, these were meant to let you gain relationship points, back when the Park wasn't even here.
We’ve worked hard on the Park and its new dialogues, which [b]are designed for much more unique heroes and personalities[/b] and are significantly upgraded versions of the end-of-mission dialogues we had before. They are personalized, better written, and allow the development of relationships outside of missions.
 
So there you have it! The changes we made in the system required a [b]new way of developing your characters' relationships[/b] outside of missions, which took the form of the Park. And to maintain narration and dialogue quality, we chose to remove the old choice dialogues at the end of missions.
 
In terms of UI, this has changed quite a bit as well. The Academy Hub features [b]two main panels related to relationships[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]The Relationships screen[/b]: This is where you can check information on the relationship status between Blade Princes and the details of the bonuses they unlocked. It serves as an informational space, [b]centered around gameplay and management[/b].
[*] [b]The Park[/b]: The Park doesn’t display key management information. It’s a [b]narrative-driven space[/b] where you can interact with clickable head icons of your Blade Princes. Doing so triggers [b]visual novel scenes with choices[/b], allowing you to win relationship points. The background of the Park is quite different from the other panels as it represents the real park of the Academy, adding more charm to this narrative space and creating a different atmosphere to set it even more apart from more tactical screens like the Black Mage Altar, for example. [i]Oh, and some characters that you can’t play might appear occasionally…[/i]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/75b317f2f983f6b1757d2bca40696b50bd920e84.png[/img]

Phew, this was quite a big devblog, there was a lot to share and break down as various systems are intertwined. Thank you for reading, let us know what you think about these recent changes!

Keep an eye out for upcoming news and insights into the creation of Blade Prince Academy. More updates are on the way!

- The Blade Prince Academy Team -

notes.title: Making the Academy into a Hub
notes.content:
Hey Blade Princes,

[h3]First and foremost, our [b]public playtes[/b]t is still [b]ongoing until December 4[/b]. [b]Register[/b] to participate and play Blade Princes Academy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333510/Blade_Prince_Academy/][b]here[/b][/url]!

[b]Fill out[/b] this [b][url=https://forms.gle/xJ9zCJ8ajXzdoYQg7]survey[/url][/b] to share your feedback![/h3]

Now that’s said, let’s move on and take a look at the [b]concept of the game's Hub[/b]—the [b]Academy[/b]! We wanted to capture the essence of the Academy and what the life of the Blade Princes was like there. In this devblog, we'll talk about why we chose the [b]features[/b] that you'll find in the Academy and [b]our process[/b] to get there!

The Academy is a [b]pivotal place[/b] in the story, founded 15 years ago by Zian Torrus, the leader of the Black Mages. The Black Mages are a group of powerful magic-wielding beings ruling over Abjectalia, the city where they founded the Academy. They are skilled users of the black arts and scholars hungry for knowledge. They took over the city of Abjectalia to maintain some kind of order and stability despite the city's chaotic nature. That’s where the Academy finds [b]its purpose[/b]—[b]a place to train elite soldiers[/b], spies and assassins with extraordinary powers. The Headmistress Malgadorae, a mysterious woman close to the Black Mages who earned their trust, is running the Academy with a strong hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/3a7eace715bcf065ea9385cddc13784cfce3eb34.png[/img]

So, it felt logical to us to [b]make the Academy the main Hub[/b] of the game. This is where your characters are trained and where they can rest after missions. It is split into areas: the [b]Black Mage Altar[/b], the [b]Main Hall[/b], the [b]Alchemist Lab[/b], the [b]Infirmary[/b] and the [b]Park[/b].

[h3]Black Mage Altar[/h3]
The [b]Black Mage Altar[/b] allows you to [b]recycle[/b] or [b]enchant pacts[/b] that you made during missions to improve your characters' stats. You can adapt your bonuses and penalties depending on how you wish to play. Recycling pacts allows you to get resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/46d511796652794c4a3a336bf18c6150363f254c.png[/img]

[h3]Main Hall[/h3]
The [b]Main Hall[/b] is where your characters can discuss each other and [b]improve their relationships[/b]. Building strong bonds with your teammates is important, they are the ones you can count on in a dire situation. This panel allows you to have a recap of each of your relationships as well as the [b]bonuses obtained via the relationships[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/821e26431e6ba0b334942ef607d93a05f4be569b.png[/img]

[h3]Alchemist Lab[/h3]
The [b]Alchemist Lab[/b] lets you [b]prepare potions[/b], [b]add new effects[/b] of resistance to negative alterations and improve them, but also [b]expand your potion holding capacity[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/69a0659e74716b9187b9cea9e79eef24a4615929.png[/img]

[h3]Infirmary[/h3]
The [b]Infirmary[/b] is where every Blade Prince who's been injured or is tired from successive missions can [b]heal and rest[/b]. You can improve the quality of their rest and the number of available beds to let more and more of your Blade Princes have the rest they deserve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/93922d890ed5aa4b90e52a0ad99e873b1dcb011a.png[/img]

[h3]Park[/h3]
The [b]Park[/b], like the Main Hall, is where your [b]characters can hang out[/b], take some fresh air and [b]talk to each other[/b]. This lets you discover [b]side stories[/b] and learn more about their backgrounds, personalities, concerns and desires, but also about the city of Abjectalia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/40ff8c292bdb51ab4ff4ff02a39eb3987432de5a.png[/img]

[h2]The Academy in the pace of the game[/h2]
The Academy has come a long way. Initially, the [b]game was a mix of roguelite and real-time tactical RPG[/b]. We liked the use of the Darkest Dungeon Hub and the dungeon crawler aspect. It also fit the lore of the Blade Princes Academy. The project has undergone major changes, and we've [b]removed the roguelite aspect[/b] [b]while keeping[/b] this [b]gameplay loop[/b]: [b]Hub -> Mission -> Hub[/b]. One of the roles of the Academy is to mark a break in the rhythm of the game after missions by being a place where you [b]manage your characters[/b], your [b]inventory[/b], [b]prepare[/b] for [b]the next fight[/b], but also [b]explore the lore[/b].

[h3]Moving on to a mission[/h3]
And when you feel ready, you can go to the [b]mission map[/b]. To [b]select[/b] the [b]area[/b] you’ll explore and [b]with which characters[/b]. Some Blade Princes may be required, depending on the mission. The map lets you see how Abjectalia was organized and how the Black Mages have been trying to watch over the city by building their palace and the Academy at its center. The eye is drawn to the different districts, each with its own color for better readability. Time to visit Abjectalia, at your own risk…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/da047afc109234ef56eeac14790f29da35dd4eaf.png[/img]

[h3]The life at the Academy[/h3]
Outside of the combat and the very pragmatic activities related to the Blade Princes’ lives, they also have desires and passions (yes, their lives do not solely revolve around fighting!). After completing a mission, you can decide to [b]let a week pass so they can rest even more and be fully ready[/b] for the next mission. Doing so makes them [b]spend your hard-earned money[/b] on hobbies and activities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/70c78578f758bdaee4efe789526fd9ac9a32b141.png[/img]

Don’t forget to [b]register [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2333510/Blade_Prince_Academy/]here[/url][/b] to take part in the [b]public playtest[/b] and to [b]fill out[/b] our [b][url=https://forms.gle/xJ9zCJ8ajXzdoYQg7]survey[/url][/b]! More updates are on the horizon! Keep an eye out for upcoming news and development insights into the creation of Blade Prince Academy.

- The Blade Prince Academy Team -

notes.title: Making Sectors 1 & 2
notes.content:
[h3]Hi fellow assassins![/h3]

Time to explore the [b]concept of the first two sectors of the game[/b]. Blade Prince Academy is a [b]tactical RPG[/b] set in a [b]blend of dark fantasy and cyberpunk influences[/b] and we aimed to transcribe this atmosphere while making memorable and challenging enemies and creating visually cool environments. We wanted to share some [b]insights on how their concepts and ideas shaped the game[/b].

[h2]Sector 1, an introduction to the universe of the game and its gameplay[/h2]

[b]Sector 1 is the first area you will explore[/b] after witnessing what happened at the Academy. You start the adventure facing the miscreants and the misfits of the city who teamed up to disrupt the missions and security of the Academy. [b]Making this sector accessible to new players is then necessary so that you can learn and experiment with the game mechanics[/b]. Therefore, some enemies that are too difficult have been deactivated for the beginning of the game, like the berserker and the bombers, which are quite challenging when starting the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/6a7478260f506c29af741b8c43a7f5e3debe7068.png[/img]

[b]Sector 1 follows the Acid Pills Gang[/b] in its first part, the ones [b]responsible for the carnage at the Academy[/b] where the tutorial takes place. [b]Phoebos and his team track down their leader[/b], [b]Acid Hair[/b], to avenge the Blade Princes and keep the honor of the Dark Mages intact. They discover that Acid Hair and his boss are linked to the Brotherhood of Torment, an organization that serves to foreshadow the upcoming battles and the enemies we will meet in Sector 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/017ca346b467276056cd329a37f4402d813c7ad7.png[/img]

The [b]main inspiration for this sector was Borderlands for the Shallows[/b], as it mixes a lot of technologies and landfills. The Acid Pills gang can be compared to Borderlands characters with [b]human or animal bodies[/b], [b]with cyberpunk upgrades[/b] to help them destroy you! We really like Acid Hair's room in this sector, it represents his personality well. Details like the cathodic TVs you can find in the environment are a sign of the not-so-advanced technologies they have in this area.


[h2]From Sector 1 to Sector 2, going deeper into the conspiracy[/h2]

[b]The Catacombs are the second part of the story[/b], contrasting in atmosphere and visuals. But also on the gameplay part, there are [b]more enemies using ranged attacks[/b], with a greater [b]focus on magic damage[/b]. This second sector follows the progression of the learning curve. [b]Many curses and afflictions[/b], like bleeding and burns, [b]will be inflicted[/b] on the heroes. We wanted to make the [b]fights even more challenging after discovering and getting the hang of the game mechanics[/b]. In this sector, we focus on the impact of alterations. Whereas in Sector 1, we had only one alteration, here we have three, which are very present. There are some specific enemies waiting for you, and they are much harder to defeat.

In the [b]level design[/b], we also have [b]more variations of settings than in the first sector[/b]. You will also [b]unlock new characters in this sector[/b], you will therefore have new tools and these characters will let you make interesting choices on team composition at the start of the mission. This sector is the home of a quite challenging and complicated boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/ae8211cc2710445738d5667af90c8abb7d5112d9.png[/img]

[b]The story of Sector 2 revolves around the Brotherhood of Torments and its leader[/b], [b]Poison[/b]. The Blade Princes must fight against hordes of Cultists to uncover hidden truths about the Brotherhood, the reason why they are involved in the attack against the Academy and their eagerness to take down the Black Mages. They will have to chase Poison throughout the sector, fighting powerful cultists and demonic abominations along the way.

For the Catacombs, the intention was to [b]do a more classic dungeon to contrast with the first sector[/b]. The inspirations were Darksiders and the classical dungeons in the D&D franchise. [b]Cults are important in this sector[/b], so you can see [b]various statues and altars[/b]. We are really proud of the parts where the cults are the center of attention. For example, we have a room with a huge statue of the God of Destruction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/f227bca1117cd769dc0636f85b78918ed8b3d10e.png[/img]

If you can’t wait to learn more about the world of Blade Prince Academy and want to discuss the game with us, join our [url=https://discord.gg/vsxD6n8P8J]Discord[/url]! Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/bpagame]Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/firesquidgames/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@firesquidgames]Tiktok[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/bladeprinceacademy/]Facebook[/url] to stay up-to-date, and you can also subscribe to our [url=https://bit.ly/FiresquidNewsletter]Newsletter[/url]!

We have a lot [b]more exciting news to share[/b] with you in the coming months! [b]Stay tuned for more content[/b], [b]development updates and other insights into the development[/b] of Blade Prince Academy.

- The Blade Prince Academy Team -

notes.title: Focus on O'Ren: the sniper
notes.content:
[h2]Meet O’ren, the powerful Sniper![/h2]

[h3]Why this choice of making a cute character so powerful?[/h3]
Originally, there was no desire to combine its cute design with its power. It's true that now it makes us smile.

This character represents physical power at a distance, and her spell kit is also very strong. She's a sniper, so it's only natural that she has the highest physical damage stats. Her spell kit includes many projectile spells and a few support spells, making her an excellent character for most missions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/2c409bacbf449df6aca1ddd290bed9434c7366af.gif[/img]

[h3]Why did we choose to change her visual novel recently?[/h3]
We wanted O'ren to be in her animal form, rather than her elf form, but she had to be different from the sniper too. So we chose to do a more puma-like color scheme and make her design match her personality: round ears and fluffy tail to show that she is kind and good-hearted, but she stays a feline and can be deadly with her claws when needed. Her green outfit reminds nature, of where she comes from, and strongly loves it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/ec6fa4240f36ffd5f20e6208328996012042219b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Where does she come from to master that great weapon?[/h3]
O'Ren was kidnapped in the Baayos jungle and raised in Abjectalia by a couple of Skadrons, a military militia under the Black Mages' orders. With her education came early training in combat, shooting and operational work.

With her animal talents and physical faculties, especially her vision, O'Ren mastered the sniper at a phenomenal speed, even surpassing the best of the best Skadrons. After her adoptive parents' death, Black Mages took an interest in her insane shooting ability and early field experience, taking her into the Blade Academy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/4750f28c428553b19e5a41cbe4225c8d2b458351.png[/img]

notes.title: Focus on the Real-Time with Pause!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi fellow assassins![/b][/h2]

We wanted to share with you some information about a core feature of our game, the real-time with pause combat system! 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMGQyODM0NzA5ZmIyZTg4YWZjY2Y2N2QwZjQxNjczZDk2OTI5NmY4YiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/QBLELCyjhpX81lkzMl/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/3adde3156c232484641805e4ab4150c408c889f6.png[/img]

[h3][b]Why did you choose to integrate the RTWP in BPA?[/b][/h3]
The vision that we had at the beginning of the project was a mixture of genres including tactical rpg in real-time. The impact of real-time on the fights is dangerous, and you have to be careful not to fall into hack-slash, which can happen if the player doesn't use the tactical pause and how he manages this pause as well as the real-time phases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/97839cfc804f27ea302809c4ef9e4fdff1b39997.png[/img]

[h3][b]What problems did the RTWP bring?[/b][/h3]
Two issues came up, one of which is still ongoing 

The first one: At the very beginning of the project, we had a time slowdown instead of a complete pause, but the rendering didn't suit us, and the player spent more time in the slowdown. He was reacting, instead of being a strategist and programming his actions. 

The second one, which is still relevant, we worked a lot on it, and there is still work to do. It's to put forward the tactical break, so the player must use it. 
We put access to spells during the tactical break, queueing, information like moves/stats etc.
And also visually, we must see in tactical break, it passes on the interface, the visual, the sounds...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/6fd706f6f4657d5ec560806c730e2fd530776ad1.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/77fe47e499ac469c0702f2ed656aed6b827e8ff1.png[/img]

[h3][b]What techniques have you implemented to make the RTWP not too messy?[/b][/h3]
In the interface, there are some elements that appear in real-time and others that disappear in tactical pause.  We had to make a choice on some interface elements. There is a great work of reflection, of test on what works / not works.

The fact that we are also in real-time adds a lot of constraints on that. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/dea30e411fb16ced9560e5a530af66b2b378ef71.png[/img]

Paying attention to the game mechanics, some have been changed/removed for readability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/5af2b78225b7254bdb044531200bbd49efb91a46.png[/img]

We hope you've enjoyed this news about the real-time with pause system in Blade Prince Academy! Let us know if you'd like to see more! Thank you so much! 

- The Blade Prince Academy Team -

notes.title: Blade Prince Academy - World and Story
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/9d81201a37c166be137c277b9c4e62723da26472.png[/img]

[h3]If you want to know more about [b]Blade Prince Academy universe[/b], this news is made for you! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/ffb9e357b2622168ea890ad5589419d5c15f633f.png[/img]

[b]Tenebrae[/b] is a dark planet, lost in the depths of the cosmos. The sun is too weak and too distant to illuminate its surface but at night, a majestic Moon fills the sky.

The planet is populated by [b]many species[/b]: humans, elves, orks, trolls, animalids, mutants etc. Its history is marked by countless conflicts between nations, kingdoms, city-states, each struggling to expand or defend its piece of territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/2263dd7b946909fb4951c6b44b5c2acc61405822.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/56c21949e45c16445acb73048bbe103246f07842.png[/img]

In Tenebrae, magic comes from the [b]vital force[/b] of everything: [b]living beings, natural elements[/b] (fire, wind, water, earth), and also [b]moonbeams[/b]. Each person has a unique affinity with it and become expert at some of its aspects: e.g elemental magic, blood magic, shadow magic, etc.

[b]Magical crystals[/b] are also extracted from the ground to serve as a valuable energy source for lighting, vehicles, weapons, and buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/500ed8497e151101f7e0ede52a406da0a72a0516.png[/img]

[b]Abjectalia[/b] was created by the Black Mages, powerful human mages banished from their original city Solaaris for forbidden magical and medical experiments.

The city has become over time the headquarters of dangerous creatures and its control has gradually slipped away from the [b]Black Mages[/b].

Consquently, they decided to create the Blade Prince Academy [b]to deal with the growing threats to Abjectalia[/b]. Its role is to detect, recruit and train young elite fighters: the Blade Princes. Most are orphans, enrolled in the Academy from an early age.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/6e94d6db650dcbdb546fff01c37fc15b7c2a08ef.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43767130/88c7e30c7d9ce2d4f96ccdaf7079c470c8d9d525.png[/img]

After a violent attack from a gang towards the Academy, Zian Torrus (the most powerful Black Mage) decides to form an elite team of students composed of Phoebos, O'Ren and Diamante to stop this new threat...

With your top-notch squad, explore the city through various types of missions. Discover powerful artifacts, defeat formidable bosses, and uncover the true events unfolding behind the scenes.

If you're intrigued by the world of Tenebrae, delve deeper into its lore with our collection of books (currently [url=https://angelcorp.org/edition/]available only in French[/url]). We have already published four captivating tales!

[h2]We're thrilled to announce our new game Blade Prince Academy![/h2]

Blade Prince Academy is a [b]party-based real-time RPG[/b] with a [b]manga-inspired artstyle[/b] and [b]dynamic, deep tactical real time combat[/b] with an emphasis on [b]timing and combos[/b].

Take control of a group of highly trained magical assassins, the [b]Blade Princes[/b], in the cyberpunk city of Abjectalia.

Unveil the city's mysteries, combat its inner and outer threats: gangs, cults, and vampires. [b]Create the best team[/b] to succeed in your missions by all means: upgrade the training facilities, manage the students' activities, foster their relationships, and make double-edged pacts with darkness! [b]Procedural maps and impactful choices[/b] for the characters give [b]massive replayability[/b] to Blade Prince Academy.
